name: Resolve trace/log source correlation
description:
Implement the data access layer for the trace side panel.

Requirements:
- From a selected log source, read log.config.traceSourceId and find the correlated trace source.
- From a selected trace source in future contexts, support trace.config.logSourceId to find the correlated log source.
- If selected row has TraceId or SpanId-like values but no correlated source exists, return a structured setup-needed state so the UI can explain that correlation must be configured.
- Query spans by TraceId from the correlated trace source without a temporal window.
- Query logs by TraceId from the correlated log source without a temporal window when available.
- Apply ORDER BY timestamp ASC and a configurable LIMIT from env with default 5000.
- Use configured source fields where present: timestampQueryField, traceIdField, spanIdField, parentSpanIdField, spanNameField, serviceNameField, durationField, durationPrecisionField, status fields, body/log attrs/span attrs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Query helpers are source-config driven.
- Missing correlation produces setup-needed state, not silent empty trace.
- Limit default is 5000 and can be configured by env.
result: Implemented trace/log correlation in apps/web/src/routes/logs/-lib/logs-row-panel.ts. The logs row adapter resolves log.config.traceSourceId against all sources, returns setup-required states when correlation or TraceId is missing, queries correlated trace source and selected log source by TraceId without temporal window, applies VITE_LOGLOG_TRACE_WATERFALL_LIMIT default 5000, orders by timestamp ASC, returns raw spans/logs plus aliases for UI normalization, and marks truncation at limit. Verification: focused Biome passed and apps/web Vite build passed.

name: Create reusable trace waterfall UI
description:
Implement the reusable frontend component for the trace panel visual experience.

Requirements:
- Reusable component, not coupled directly to /logs route.
- Langfuse-style dense tree/waterfall visual: root trace icon, span/log/error/warning icons, tree guide lines, duration text, compact row names.
- Search input filters by name, service, span id, body, status/severity while keeping ancestors of matching nodes.
- Header right side has only raw JSON download and collapse button.
- Panel is collapsible.
- Rows hover-highlight and use pointer cursor. Click only updates internal selected/active row state for now; no detail panel behavior yet.
- No timeline axis, graph view, service map, or right-detail trace view in this task.

Acceptance criteria:
- Component handles loading, error, empty, setup-needed, and result states.
- Component accepts raw export payload and downloads JSON.
- Visual implementation follows existing app UI primitives and Tailwind patterns.
result: Implemented reusable TraceWaterfallPanel in apps/web/src/components/trace-waterfall/trace-waterfall-panel.tsx with Langfuse-style TRACE tree, search, download raw JSON, collapse rail, hover/selected row states, span/log/error/warning icons, tree guide lines, duration labels, setup/loading/error/empty/result states. Verification: focused Biome passed and apps/web Vite build passed.

name: Add Langfuse-style trace waterfall side panel
description:
Plan and implement a reusable trace waterfall side panel for the web app logs drawer.

Background:
- Visual reference: Langfuse trace detail tree/waterfall only. Do not implement timeline graph or service map.
- Data logic reference: HyperDX side panel correlation for OTEL + ClickHouse, especially mixing logs into trace view by TraceId and SpanId.
- Current stashed data-row-side-panel files must be ignored for planning context.

Product requirements:
- Show trace panel only when selected row has trace-like attributes and trace source correlation can be resolved or needs setup guidance.
- Panel appears on the left inside the existing row detail drawer. Drawer remains 70vw on desktop; trace panel occupies 30 percent of that drawer when present, and main detail area occupies remaining 70 percent.
- If selected log has trace/span attributes but no correlated trace source is configured, render an instructional state explaining that source correlation must be configured.
- Panel is collapsible, with collapse icon beside download button.
- Header includes only raw JSON download action and collapse action on the right.
- Include search input.
- Render only Langfuse-style tree/waterfall, not a timeline axis.
- Match Langfuse details closely: trace/root icon, tree guide lines, duration per row, naming conventions, dense trace navigation feel.
- Include spans plus logs in same waterfall. Spans define tree by SpanId and ParentSpanId. Logs attach as leaves under the span with matching SpanId. Logs with missing/unmatched SpanId become roots with warning icon.
- Items should look clickable and hover-highlight now, but selection behavior is internal only until future detail-click work.
- Component must be reusable across panels.

Data requirements:
- Use source correlation fields: log.config.traceSourceId and trace.config.logSourceId.
- Query without temporal window.
- Use configurable env limit with default 5000.
- Trace schema Duration is UInt64 with durationPrecisionField default 9, so default interpretation is nanoseconds.
- Download exports raw JSON, expected shape { spans, logs }.

Acceptance criteria:
- Approved implementation plan exists in dex subtasks.
- Implementation later includes focused tree builder tests and verifies lint/typecheck/build as appropriate.
result: Implemented the reusable Langfuse-style trace waterfall side panel for the logs drawer. Added the optional trace panel adapter contract, source-correlation lookup from log source to trace source, ClickHouse fetches for spans and logs by TraceId without temporal window, and the reusable trace-waterfall model/UI. The UI renders root spans directly, includes logs in the same waterfall, has search, collapse, raw JSON download, compact tree guide lines, Langfuse-inspired root/span icons, and setup guidance when trace attributes exist but source correlation is missing. Added VITE_LOGLOG_TRACE_WATERFALL_LIMIT with default behavior of 5000 and documented the implementation in docs/web/componentes/trace-waterfall-side-panel.md. Verification: builder tests passed with 5 tests / 12 expects; focused Biome check for code paths passed during implementation; apps/web build passed during implementation; git diff --check passed after the documentation update. Typecheck was attempted and failed on pre-existing server errors in apps/server/src/features/sources/routes.ts, outside this component. Docs validation was intentionally skipped per user instruction.

name: Build trace waterfall tree model
description:
Create reusable pure logic for normalizing spans/logs and building the Langfuse-style waterfall tree.

Requirements:
- Normalize raw span rows and raw log rows into a shared TraceWaterfallItem model.
- Spans define canonical hierarchy by SpanId and ParentSpanId.
- Logs attach as leaf children to the span with the same SpanId, using synthetic ids so they never overwrite span nodes.
- Logs with missing or unmatched SpanId become root-level nodes and carry a warning marker for the UI.
- Sort roots and siblings by timestamp ASC.
- Flatten with DFS pre-order for render/search.
- Always include a visual TRACE wrapper root for Langfuse-like structure.
- Duration uses trace source durationPrecisionField, default 9 for nanoseconds.

Acceptance criteria:
- Pure builder has no React dependency.
- Tests cover nested spans, multiple roots, orphan spans, matched logs, unmatched logs, timestamp ordering, and duration formatting inputs.
result: Implemented pure trace waterfall builder in apps/web/src/components/trace-waterfall/trace-waterfall-model.ts. It normalizes spans/logs, builds TRACE wrapper, attaches logs to matching spans, promotes unmatched logs with warning state, sorts by timestamp ASC, flattens DFS, filters search while preserving ancestors, and formats duration using durationPrecision. Verification: bun test apps/web/src/components/trace-waterfall/trace-waterfall-model.test.ts passed 5 tests / 12 expects; focused Biome passed.
